actor_notes: LOOKS: Adult working man in plain dock clothes; currently off work recovering from an earlier beating, no newly specified injury. CORE: A boat owner who needs his working property back to earn a living and does not want another confrontation with soldiers. NATURE: Direct, familiar with his own craft and wary of promises. WANTS: Recover his skiff and return to paid work when well enough. PRESSURE: Gives physical identifying details and asks for an actual safe handover, not speeches. SPEECH: Plain dockside descriptions, no legal exposition. Knows his own boat, not Hanzo's secrets or Halla's private appointments.
